decisions.reason: The font and two-line arrangement apply only to the referenced bottle design; the stamped-meat design retains its independent stamped slogan treatment.
The source changes typography for the bottle design only and does not alter the grill design's smoke-rendered slogan or readability requirement.
The source refers to a different design and does not change the Riverton sky text bubble, text span, or place name.
Selecting a font and straight-line text arrangement for one design does not change the requirement that all artwork be hand-drawn and non-AI.
